offer.speaker: iruka
offer.text: A shinobi without tools is a shinobi in trouble. Here are some kunai.

offer.speaker: iruka
offer.text: Throw them at the training dummy by the targets. Aim for the chest!

steps.text: Hit the training dummy with kunai
on_start: execute unless entity @e[type=naruto_shippuden:training_dummy,x=-68,y=65,z=-58,distance=..3] run summon naruto_shippuden:training_dummy -68 65 -58

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: Nice throws! Now, taijutsu. Kiba's been itching for a match all morning.

dialogue.speaker: kiba
dialogue.text: Finally! Akamaru and I are gonna wipe the floor with you, rookie!

dialogue.speaker: kiba
dialogue.text: Tch... not bad. Akamaru says you got lucky. ...Rematch later!

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: A fine match. Remember: a real fight isn't won with strength alone, but with what you see coming.
